title: Growth
coreMove: Judge growth by whether it strengthens the strategy or dissolves its focus.
sourcePressure: Growth is tested as a strategic outcome with costs and constraints, not an automatic virtue; expansion matters only when it preserves or strengthens strategic force. Frozen source has no chapter-specific named figure, study, place, or event beyond the visible title/support notes; use conceptual source terms only and do not invent anchors.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Growth is always evidence that strategy is working.
